title: Add angular-eslint to an existing workspace

skipInstall.description: Skip package installation after adding dependencies

setParserOptionsProject.description: Whether or not to enable rules that require type information by configuring the ESLint `parserOptions.projectService` option. We do not do this by default for lint performance reasons. Implied when tseslintPreset is a type-checked preset.

tseslintPreset.description: Which typescript-eslint shared config preset to extend in the generated ESLint config. Type-checked presets also enable parserOptions.projectService (required for those rules, but slower). See https://typescript-eslint.io/users/configs/
